title: pvColorByArray
body:
## pvColorByArray

Converts one single-component point array of an image (vtkImageData) into colour values by passing it through a lookup table, producing image data whose scalars are unsigned char luminance, luminance-alpha, RGB (ParaView default) or RGBA tuples. Connect the LookupTable input to a lookup-table resource node such as pvResourcePVLookupTable; its value range and colours decide the mapping. Use it to bake a colour map into image data, e.g. before writing a PNG with pvWritePNGWriter; for on-screen colouring use scene appearance settings instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Without a LookupTable the filter only passes the input through, which works only for unsigned char data already in the output format; always connect a lookup table.
- The result holds colours, not the original values; keep the source image for quantitative work.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ColorByArray`. Identity: `filters/ColorByArray`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `LookupTable` | Optional: the colour lookup-table resource (a pvResourcePVLookupTable node) used by the native LookupTable property. Give the id of that resource node in this document. Resources are configuration objects, not data results, so no output port can be selected. | False | one object | `lookup-table` | `{"compatibility":"native-proxy-group","cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","rating":"unknown"},"nativeGroup":"lookup_tables"}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ColorBy` | This property specifies the name of the scalar array from which we will color by. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `OutputFormat` | Number and meaning of the colour components written per pixel. RGB gives three 8-bit channels for ordinary colour images; RGBA adds the lookup table's opacity, for images that will be composited; Luminance and Luminance Alpha give a single grey channel (with or without alpha), which saves space but loses hue. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Luminance","Luminance Alpha","RGB","RGBA"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Luminance"` |
| `RGBANaNColor` | Colour as [red, green, blue, alpha], each 0 to 255, written for points flagged invalid by the input's vtkValidPointMask array, such as points outside the source domain after resampling. It is not the colour for NaN values in the mapped array; those take the lookup table's own NaN colour. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":4,"minItems":4,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1]` |

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",

```
